intervals.note: Terminal event copied from the experiment record; marks the end of the experiment's data taking, not a dissolution date of the collaboration.
intervals.quote: The CCFR collaboration collected data from two fixed-target runs at Fermilab in 1985 (experiment E744) and 1987-88 (experiment E770).
